about: Renders buttons that stay pressed: one at a time, as a choice, or several at once, as a set of toggles. The arrow keys move between the buttons, and Space and Enter toggle the focused one.

looks.about: The button's looks, as one attached strip. A button that is on takes its look's pressed fill, one step deeper than the look's rest. The `solid` look marks a pressed button with an inset shadow and a semibold label, which an icon does not show.
looks.title: Looks

orientation.about: `orientation="vertical"` stacks the buttons, and the up and down arrow keys move between them.
orientation.title: Orientation

single.about: Without `multiple` the group keeps one button on and reads as a set of radios. `deselectable={false}` keeps a button on when it is pressed again.
single.title: One at a time

sizes.about: The button's sizes, so a group in a toolbar is as tall as the buttons beside it.
sizes.title: Sizes

spaced.about: `attached={false}` spaces the buttons by the group's gap. Archived is disabled, and the arrow keys skip it.
spaced.title: Spaced

states.about: A disabled group dims every button and takes none out of the row.
states.title: Disabled

title: Toggle group
